findings.issue: וַתֹּאמֶר is qal sequential 3fs (she said). Unmarked dijo continues the previous masculine subject Jehová as the speaker.
רְגָלִים is a common noun, feminine plural (feet). veces replaces that noun with occasions.
זֶה is a masculine singular demonstrative; estas is feminine plural, agreement smoothing with veces.

notes: Jehová, la asna, and the 1cs/2ms strike clause match the tokens.
